core_competencies.why: Strong commercial negotiation of cloud and SaaS deals and pricing, but not as an attorney; escalates legal terms to counsel.

relevant_experience.why: 10+ years of contracts work, but not in a legal environment as a lawyer.

industry_functional.why: Healthcare payer and logistics procurement, not a technology company legal team.

career_level_years.why: Senior in procurement, but a contracts manager is not a counsel-level role.

location_work_arrangement.why: Seattle, WA; role is remote anywhere in the US.

education_certification.why: No JD; the JD degree is an explicit requirement.

must_haves.evidence: B.A. Business Administration, University of Washington, 2015

must_haves.requirement: Minimum 8 years of experience in a legal environment
must_haves.evidence: working alongside in-house counsel who approve the final legal terms

must_haves.requirement: Significant experience negotiating complex SaaS, cloud services, technology infrastructure and commercial transactions

must_haves.requirement: Comfort advising on data privacy, data security, AI and general commercial risk in technology supplier agreements
must_haves.evidence: escalate liability, indemnity and data terms to counsel

must_haves.requirement: Strong understanding of cloud computing business models, contracting structures and pricing frameworks, including consumption-based models and committed spend arrangements
must_haves.evidence: Negotiated pricing, volume tiers and committed-spend discounts for the company's primary cloud contract

must_haves.requirement: Experience partnering with Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, Finance and Procurement stakeholders on high-value technology deals
Experience translating negotiated contract terms into scalable internal processes and operational guidance
must_haves.evidence: Track renewals for 600+ IT vendors in Coupa

must_haves.requirement: US-based (remote anywhere in the US; US based applicants only)

disqualifiers_present: No JD degree (role requires a JD); not a practicing attorney
notes: Weak: strong cloud-deal negotiator who lacks the JD the role requires (adjacent profession). Tests that pricing/cloud keyword overlap does not outweigh a hard requirement.
